item.title: Tide skins Gators, 73-67, to advance in playoffs
item.description: Minden held off a furious comeback by the LaGrange Gators to give the Tide a 73-67 win Friday in the opening round of the LHSAA Class 4A Division II (Non-Select) state playoffs. item.title: Minden City Council votes to donate playground equipment to Town of Sibley
item.description: By Bonnie Culverhouse A cooperative endeavor agreement between City of Minden and Town of Sibley means children living in south Webster Parish will have more playground equipment. According to the resolution approved by Minden City Council, equipment from the recreation complex is being replaced, therefore, the current equipment is surplus and being donated to Sibley … Continue reading Minden City Council votes to donate playground equipment to Town of Sibley

item.title: Firearm charge filed against Minden man
item.description: By Pat Culverhouse Police officers turned a response to a disturbance at a local residence in the early morning hours Monday into the arrest of a Minden man on a firearms charge. item.title: Minden’s council appoints judge, clerk to new administrative court
item.description: By Bonnie Culverhouse Minden’s new administrative court will soon be in session. During Monday’s Minden City Council meeting, it was decided unanimously to appoint the city’s special attorney Neil Erwin as administrative judge and the city’s administrative assistant Ashlee Drake as docket clerk in addition to their current duties with the city.
